english.note: This is the everyday choice for physically walking or moving closer to a person or thing.

exampleSentences.english: Don't approach the stove, or you'll get burned.
exampleSentences.traditional: 你唔好行近個火爐，會辣親㗎。
exampleSentences.jyutping: nei5 m4 hou2 haang4 gan6 go3 fo2 lou4 wui5 laat6 can1 gaa3

english.note: Use this when a person moves forward toward someone or somewhere, meaning ‘approach’.

exampleSentences.english: They slowly advance toward me and ask for directions.
exampleSentences.traditional: 佢慢慢行近我，問我攞路。
exampleSentences.jyutping: keoi5 maan6 maan6 haang4 gan6 ngo5 man6 ngo5 lo2 lou6
